record.question: How many Fundamental Duties are there currently?
record.explanation: Answer D: 11. There are 11 Fundamental Duties in Article 51A. Reference: https://legislative.gov.in/constitution-of-india/. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical context: General Studies Paper-II, January 2026 examination; current affairs are interpreted as of the paper date.. Officeholders, survey results and forecasts refer to that original paper, not necessarily the present. No matching examiner key is asserted.
